phases.mints: per-token address-filtered scans, 127 tokens, creation block -> 27,460,383
phases.custom: chain-wide Recovery/Published/TTDATA, fork -> 24,532,968 (abandoned in FDIC spam era; chunk 24512969_24532968 excluded as silent-empty known-bad)

_meta.dedupe: on (block, log_index, address) across and within phases
known_limitations: V3 withdraw() flips Debenture silently (no event) - debenture windows inferred only from current state / claim reverts
FDIC and MV excluded from per-token scans (unscannable spam/drip eras); FDIC economics from state snapshot, MV from mv phase + snapshot
custom phase ends at block 24,532,968: chain-wide Recovery/Published/TTDATA totals are complete only to that block; interest-token totals are complete to 27,460,383 via the mints phase
month buckets use piecewise-linear block->timestamp interpolation over onchain anchor headers (census creation timestamps + w3b_block_times + fork block)
